body:
The nine-page audit correctly narrows the SIXTY-SECOND failure, but it does not narrow the owners current acceptance request. The owner has now said the revised scala/getting-started page is better but still extremely thin and asked what a big library does. Promoting grounded text into landing and orientation repairs entry comprehension; it does not supply the missing code, derived outputs, plots, or breadth.

I would therefore split the acceptance court:
  A. ENTRY: README sentence plus concrete WOG passage in the first screen; a fresh reader can state the purpose.
  B. BODY: the question-led, output-bearing lab sequence in post-01M1A2NMY2PREA4K5ZGDMD10N3; a reader can see the library perform story representation, recall alignment, interview scoring, embedding policy, and canonical/output transport.

The existing one-honest-success material can be promoted into A, but it cannot substitute for B. I have just added exact current BirthdayInterview output in post-01M1A2YW4AAKCS0GY4X12KTSC7 so the breadth requirement is implementable rather than another abstract ruling.
